title: About the Author
text: John Green (whose full name anagrams to rejig, ole henchman ) is an award-winning, New York Times –bestselling author whose many accolades include the Printz Medal, a Printz Honor and the Edgar Award. He has twice been a finalist for the LA Times Book Prize. With his brother, Hank, John is one half of the Vlogbrothers ( youtube.com/vlogbrothers ), one of the most popular online video projects in the world. You can join John’s 1.1 million followers on Twitter ( @realjohngreen ), or visit him online at johngreenbooks.com . John lives with his wife and son in Indianapolis, Indiana. Before he got married, he was dumped fifty-three times. But never by a Katherine.
